class: source-only developmental successor; not independent first-use science
question: Can a tokenless learner synthesize new multi-stage input-variable relationships from primitive Boolean gates, from witnessed real one-bit interventions, and predict unseen input combinations better than fully fitted generic learners and a same-input single-relation ablation?
important_limit: Synthesizing graph structures from a known, finite grammar is not inventing primitives outside the grammar, autonomous intelligence, persistent reasoning or independent science.
hypothesis: Unenumerated two-level compositions of XOR/AND/OR with learned four-variable bindings, optional output inversion, fitted solely to 16 real public do observations, have >=0.05 higher heldout accuracy than the strongest same-data fully-trained generic learner; they do not lose >0.02 accuracy to that learner on disjoint non-grammar functions.

world.truth_generator: y = optional NOT( root( left(x_a,x_b), right(x_c,x_d) ) ) with (a,b,c,d) all distinct and left/right/root each XOR/AND/OR. Privileged world objects available only inside fixture generator/evaluator, never model input.
world.intervention_protocol: For each fixture/world, order 64 input assignments by SHA256 ASCII 'AAI12S|<fixture>|<worldindex>|<x>', then greedily select first 8 disjoint pairs (x, x xor (1<<bit)) using bit directions 0..5. These are 8 actually executed one-bit do interventions and 16 unique public x/y observations per arm. No model-specific action selection.
world.test_protocol: All 48 input assignments absent from the public 16 are evaluation-only; 2 fixtures x 12 unfamiliar worlds x 48 cases =1152 transfer cases per arm. Also 384 familiar (4x2x48) and 384 disjoint out-of-grammar negative (4x2x48), scored separately.
world.model_observations: Only public x (6 bits), y (1 bit) and witnessed one-bit do edges between paired examples. No world ID, true graph, gate label, hidden state, source family or evaluator truth.

learner.synth: Search all ordered four-distinct-variable bindings over x[0:6], 3 primitive ops for each of 3 graph nodes, and optional output complement; this is a compositional program grammar, NOT an enumerated ground-truth graph list. Train by minimizing 16-sample exact classification errors, break ties by short description then lexicographic expression; compute full 64-bit Boolean truth table for each program once using only permitted primitive operations, never privileged target structure. No post-result grammar expansion.
learner.same_data_ablation: single_gate_only (two arbitrary input variables, XOR/AND/OR and optional output inversion), identical 16 public x/y observations and disjoint-test budget.
learner.fitting: ID3 trains to entropy/purity or depth6 on all 16 public observations; logistic uses all 42 squarefree monomials up to degree3, full-batch gradient descent 500 epochs, learning rate=0.5 and L2=0.01, deterministic zero-init, no post-result tuning; kNN uses 5 nearest Hamming with deterministic order tie; recent table uses observed exact x else global empirical majority.
learner.cold: All models trained afresh per independently restored world/fixture; no reuse of target truth. Grammar truth table optimization is fixed-capacity source-free and shared across worlds.

frozen_gates.classify: DEV_ADMITTED_SCIENCE_UNVERIFIED only if all frozen gates pass and exact paired source+negative controls are reproducible; else DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE. If provenance, state, leakage, parity or training assertions fail, classify INVALID_ENGINEERING instead of scientific negative.
frozen_gates.negative_control: Out-of-grammar functions must be tested for honest scope; no relabeling these as ordinary transfer.
frozen_gates.stop: One source-only mechanical screen at frozen SHA; no post-result tuning, reshuffling, scaling, multiple hypotheses on same results, fresh science cohorts or automatic promotion.

safety.external_git_ci: nonqualification workflows may fire; native final regression required only before any merge
